title: The drawn plate
summary: You liked the hanging plate but felt the logo symbol across it was too much, and asked for it mixed with the capability sheet. The plate now hangs from hero X's exact bar. Its top row is one drawn signal line: a waveform for Narrative Systems, a routed line for GTM Infrastructure and a closing ring for GTM Intelligence. The open column's drawing resolves while the others rest, and the logo symbol appears nowhere except the Kelwin lockup.

reference.site: Round 1 · A + C (nav A 'The hanging plate' × nav C 'The capability sheet')
reference.borrowed: From nav A (Pinterest's business-hub menu): the full-width plate that drops from the bar's hairline, three equal strips divided by full-height 1px verticals, a figure row with one hairline under all three strips, CAP. index, wide title, descriptor and a four-row manifest per strip, the hover bar on a row, and the info band along the bottom edge. From nav C (Bird's ruled header and the drawing sheet it opened): master → detail selection, where choosing a capability changes its drawing and the sheet's narration; 1px technical line work with square nodes and a dashed 'indirect' state; coded rows (C-02.1); and a segmented title block in the bottom band.
reference.kelwin: The plate keeps A's metrics (96px bar, 24px lockup, 12px tracked caps, outlined AUDIT REQUEST ↗, cols 1–4 / 5–8 / 9–12) but the nested-corner mark row is gone. In its place is one drawing set: a single signal line crosses the plate, and each strip's run of it is that capability's DIRECTION-AC glyph. Narrative Systems is CONTOUR: five contour lines converge into one. GTM Infrastructure is TRACE: an orthogonal route with three nodes and one packet. GTM Intelligence is ORBIT: an open ring that closes, with a core ring and one riding node. C's master/detail becomes the open strip. Its glyph resolves in --fg with its one signature morph, the hairline under its drawing seats in --fg, its title and CAP lift, and the title block narrates the drawing: 'Signal | Cap. 02 | Routed' (Settled for 01, Closed for 03, Raw while nothing is open). The other strips keep their raw drawings (an unsettled bundle, a dashed sketch route, a ring open by 40°) in --fg-3, so hovering a capability literally shows what Kelwin installs. Rows carry C-style codes (02.1–02.4). C's cells, iso slabs, K-labels, leaders, dimension lines, SHEET/REV furniture and mono paragraphs are not used. The band is the two doors: 'Every engagement opens with a fixed-scope audit.' over the quiet 'Talk to the team →' (/contact) and the red 'Request a System Audit ↗' (/audit) flush in the corner. That red is the section's only red.

motion: entrance: the bar hairline draws left to right (900ms) and the open item's 1px marker draws on it (500ms at 500ms). The hero frame's two registration marks fade in at the hairline ends. The plate unrolls down from the hairline (clip-path, 700ms --ease-out, at 350ms), the strip verticals draw top-down through the band (700ms at 700ms), titles rise out of masks (800ms, 120ms stagger from 800ms), CAP labels and descriptors fade up (1100ms), the manifest rows cascade (80ms stagger from 1150ms) and the band fades in (1100ms).

entrance (drawing, travels the reading path): each strip's run of the signal is wiped on left to right in drafting order (900ms --ease-inout at 850 / 1250 / 1650ms), so the raw line runs 01 → 03 across the plate. Nothing is open yet, and the title block reads 'Signal | Cap. 01–03 | Raw'.

orchestrated moment (demo at ~2.4s): the pointer settles on CAP. 02. Its route plots solid over the dashed sketch (stroke-dashoffset, 900ms --ease-inout), and the three nodes latch outline → filled as the line reaches them (at 12% / 44% / 77% of the path). The hairline under its drawing seats in --fg (600ms), the title and CAP lift to --fg, row 02.2 takes the --panel-2 bar (demo only), and the title block swaps to 'Cap. 02 | Routed' (old value out in 180ms, new value in 320ms, never both at once). At ~3.4s one 6px packet, knocked out from the line, starts running the route at constant speed (12s per lap, linear).

interaction: hovering or focusing a strip opens it; the last strip opened stays open until another is chosen (no flicker as the pointer crosses the band to the doors). 01 CONTOUR settles by JS sample interpolation (1400ms: the convergence point moves from x 372 to 216 and the amplitude falls from 6.5 to 4) into one long clean line. 02 TRACE resolves as above. 03 ORBIT closes its 40° gap (1000ms), the core ring accretes (700ms at 500ms), the join node latches and one node rides the ring (16s per lap, counter-rotated so the square stays square); when the strip closes the rider stops where it is, with no snap. The first real interaction drops the demo's resting row, so only the hovered row lights (--panel-2). Title arrows nudge 3px, the outlined nav action's border goes to --fg, and the red door deepens to --accent-hover with its ↗ moving 2px up-right.

ambient: the hero film (the hero's calibration: blur 8px, frost .2, 32s drift, grain) shows through around and under the plate, plus at most one drawing loop, owned by the open strip (the TRACE packet at 12s or the ORBIT rider at 16s per lap). CONTOUR has no loop.

on the live site: the plate opens on hover or focus of CAPABILITIES (aria-expanded) with nothing open, the strip under the pointer or keyboard focus opens, and the plate closes on Esc or pointer-leave. The 2.4s auto-open of CAP. 02 and its resting row are demo only. Reduced motion (no .is-play; KM.init with reduced:true) renders the final state synchronously: CAP. 02 open, route solid, packet parked on the top run, no loops and no timers.
notes: Stage is 900px (one 1440×900 screen). The film plate is re-framed at .85 scale and lowered (top 294px, left −96px) so that below the plate the seated colleague reads clearly — head and white-shirted shoulders between two backs — and, during the entrance, the two men's heads and the two colleagues behind them. The glyph mapping follows DIRECTION-AC §5.1 and the nav's three glyphs count as one drawing set. C quotas used: 0 callouts, 0 dimension lines, 2 registration marks, 1 title block (3 cells), and mono only as CAP. codes, row indices and title-block values (each one line, ≤ 40 characters). The two + marks sit at the bar hairline's ends. They belong to the hero's content frame (§3.4 ①), not to the plate, so the plate itself carries no registration frame. Strokes are snapped to half pixels for crisp 1px lines; the five CONTOUR lines are drawn in opaque --fg and dimmed as one group, so their convergence never stacks into a brighter stub. The CONTOUR paths come from a seeded PRNG (mulberry32, seed 1307) in X.js (window.KM.contour), and the t=0 paths are inlined into X.html so the no-JS default is the final drawing. X.html is generated from scratchpad/nav-X.tpl.html by scratchpad/fill-nav.cjs, so edit the template and re-run it rather than editing X.html by hand. Both audit entry points (outlined bar action and red plate door) go to /audit; the quiet door goes to /contact. The title block is aria-hidden because it repeats the strip headings, so hovering does not make screen readers chatter. Checked in this pass: no logo glyphs anywhere in the plate (the lint counts 0 mark uses; the lockup is the only Kelwin mark). Nothing is under 11px: titles 30px, descriptors and service rows 15px, the band note 15px, CAP. codes and the title block 12px mono, and row indices 11px mono. The bar matches hero X's exactly: the lockup at 64/36 (24px tall), the five items at the same x positions (12px, .18em tracking), AUDIT REQUEST at 1191/26 (185×44), the hairline at 96 between the margins and the + marks at its ends. The only addition is the open item's 1px underline on the hairline, which marks CAPABILITIES as open. · Promoted unchanged from round-2 slot X.
addressed: 'The logo symbol across the navigation is too much' → removed. The only mark is the Kelwin lockup at top-left.
'Some other system drawing set' → each capability has its own drawing: a waveform settling into one line, a routed signal, a ring that closes.
'Combine the capability sheet with the hanging plate' → A's plate and three strips, with C's drawing set as the top row and coded service rows (01.1–03.4).
Readable → 30px titles, 15px descriptors and service rows, and nothing under 11px.
One family with the hero → the bar is identical to hero X's, measured to the pixel.
The System Audit stays the one red door, with Talk to the team beside it.
